text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian claims her second crown<n>at the
Japanese Derby. While the<n>entire racing world is
abuzz, Biwa<n>Hayahide speaks at a press
conference for the upcoming<n>Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There, she declares that not only will<n>she win the
Takarazuka Kinen, she<n>will eventually compete
against her<n>sister.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There's more attention on her than<n>ever before.
Meanwhile, I gather data<n>on her competition to give
her the<n>best chance of success.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I watch footage of the Derby for<n>research and am
shocked by the<n>unbelievable speed Narita Brian can
put forth. It's no wonder they call her<n>the Beast.
